schema.text: Thinking about your typical trip (the trip you make most often in a typical week), how safe are the streets you use, in terms of traffic and road conditions?

en.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Thinking about your typical trip (the trip you make most often in a typical week), how safe are the streets you use, in terms of traffic and road conditions?

it.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale (quello che fai più spesso in una settimana tipica), quanto è sicuro muoverti sulle strade che usi, per quanto riguarda il traffico e le condizioni della strada?

fr.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: En pensant à votre trajet habituel (celui que vous faites le plus souvent au cours d’une semaine type), à quel point est-il sûr de circuler dans les rues que vous empruntez, côté circulation et état de la chaussée ?

de.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Wenn Sie an Ihren typischen Weg denken (den Weg, den Sie in einer typischen Woche am häufigsten zurücklegen): Wie sicher sind die Straßen, die Sie nutzen, in Bezug auf Verkehr und Straßenzustand?

tr.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Tipik yolculuğunuzu (tipik bir haftada en sık yaptığınız yolculuk) düşündüğünüzde, kullandığınız sokaklar trafik ve yol koşulları açısından ne kadar güvenli?

fa.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: با در نظر گرفتن سفر معمول خود (سفری که در یک هفته معمولی بیشتر از همه انجام می‌دهید)، خیابان‌هایی که استفاده می‌کنید از نظر ترافیک و وضعیت جاده چقدر امن هستند؟

hu.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Szokásos útjára gondolva (amelyet egy átlagos héten a leggyakrabban tesz meg), mennyire biztonságosak az Ön által használt utcák a forgalom és az útviszonyok szempontjából?

ar.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: بالتفكير في رحلتك المعتادة (الرحلة الأكثر تكرارًا في أسبوع عادي)، ما مدى أمان الطرق المستخدمة من حيث حركة المرور وحالة الطريق؟
